notes: Full class-A catalog metadata are present; only the declared 100 optimized event light curves are included.
Pilot selection was frozen using published catalog fit values before any new light-curve fitting; no new scientific fits have been performed.
Two tables describe the same 3560 parent events; do not count them twice.
The benchmark is one previously studied physical event, observed by multiple instruments and filters.
Initial connectivity probes returned transient HTTP503 for three OGLE resources; subsequent bounded retries succeeded. The probe light curve is excluded from this pilot package.
Publisher MD5 values were checked for the Zenodo files; SHA256 was calculated for every downloaded file.
No blanket data license is inferred from public accessibility; preserve attribution and source-specific terms.
